title: Add service-zone proof and KMS usage attester
author: Priya Sharma
description:
Motivation: Customers in regulated regions asked for deterministic proof that a request was routed and served within an asserted geographic zone and that the KMS used for encryption was allowed by the tenant's residency policy. This PR adds a lightweight service-zone proof generator (signed assertions emitted with the response metadata) and a KMS usage attester that records, signs, and surfaces which KMS key and region were used to encrypt at-rest artifacts.

Scope: The change spans three areas: (1) RBAC/v2 policy checks are extended with a zone-claim validator that enforces 'exact-zone' matches when tenants opt into strict residency controls; (2) a KMS usage attester service that emits tamper-evident attestation objects into the audit stream and a short-lived HMAC signature for internal cross-service verification; (3) audit pipeline enhancements that persist zone proofs and KMS attestations as immutable audit envelope entries and surface them in the Console.

Design notes: Zone proof is intentionally minimal: a signed JSON assertion containing service_id, request_id, asserted_zone, timestamp, and a hash of the request KV-cache snapshot. Signatures use our existing edge signing key (rotated via kms/keys/edge-rotation flow); attestation objects for KMS usage include key_id, provider, region, and a signing proof derived from the KMS-anchored signer. All signing operations are abstracted behind a new attestation interface so backends can be swapped (HSM/KMS).

Backward compatibility and rollout: Feature-gated under 'enable_zone_proofs' and 'attach_kms_attestations' flags in config. Default off for all tenants. We will enable a shadow mode (emit to audit pipeline only) for two weeks before surfacing in responses. RBAC policy compiler will accept the new 'zone: exact' predicate but it will only be enforced when the tenant flag is enabled.

Testing & QA: Unit tests for policy compiler and attestation serialization included. Integration test harness added to eval-harness to run synthetic multi-region routing and validate signature chain. Manual verification checklist performed against staging: key rotation, revocation behavior, and observer de-duplication.

Related work: Linear ENG-9317 (tenant residency enforcement), SEC-214 (audit proof formats), and a follow-up onboarding doc (docs/security/tenant-zone-onboarding).

Release notes: When enabled, Redwood can emit a cryptographically-signed zone proof and a KMS usage attestation per request. These are persisted in the immutable audit envelope and optionally surfaced to tenants via the Console.

Security review: SEC reviewed the attestation formats and approved the entropy and TTL bounds for short-lived proofs. See SEC review thread for details.

release_notes:
- New optional feature: cryptographically-signed service zone proofs per request (feature-gated).
- New optional feature: KMS usage attestations persisted to immutable audit envelopes.
- RBAC/v2: new 'zone: exact' predicate supported by policy compiler (enforced only when tenant enables residency controls).
notes_for_ops: Ops: to enable for a tenant, set enable_zone_proofs=true and attach_kms_attestations=true in tenant config. Ensure edge signing key rotation has been completed and that KMS providers used by the tenant support GetPublicKey for verification. Rolling restart of service nodes is required for config flag pickup in current release; this will be automated in next release. Monitor metric attestation.emit_failures and audit.envelope.write_latency.
